'''2008 Worlds Team Casey Anis LS You Can Either Profit By This...''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Casey Anis]] at [[2008 World Championship]] (Team Tournament).

* '''Player:''' [[Casey Anis]]
* '''Event:''' [[2008 World Championship]]

* '''Stage:''' Team Tournament
